title: Self-Interested Giving: The Relationship Between Conditional Gifts, Charitable Donations, and Donor Self-Interestedness
eligible_reason: Laboratory/online experiments on conditional gifts and donations (Studies 1-5); within-subject random-effects regressions of donation on product and charity ratings, t-tests and linear mixed models. No DiD or staggered-adoption design.
design_notes: Manuscript, Stata Analysis.do: xtreg donation b10.productrating if charityrating==k, i(subid) re robust; R Analysis.r: linear mixed models (Studies 3, 4B).
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2021.4039.txt); no DiD terms.
